name: Software Engineer
description: A software engineer designs, develops, tests, and maintains computer programs and systems to solve problems and improve processes through coding and technical expertise.
products: System Software, Application Software, Development Software, Database Software, Embedded Software, Networking Software, Security Software, etc.

name: Data Scientist
description: A data scientist analyzes and interprets complex data to help companies make decisions, using statistical, machine learning, and data visualization methods.
products: Predictive Models, Data Dashboards, Analytical Reports, Machine Learning Pipelines, AI Solutions
tools_and_tech: Python, R, Jupyter, TensorFlow, SQL, Tableau, Power BI

name: Mechanical Engineer
description: A mechanical engineer designs, builds, and tests mechanical devices, from engines to HVAC systems, ensuring functionality and efficiency.
products: Automotive Parts, HVAC Systems, Industrial Equipment, Robotics, Consumer Devices
tools_and_tech: SolidWorks, AutoCAD, MATLAB, 3D Printers, CNC Machines

name: Nurse
description: A nurse provides patient care, administers medication, supports doctors, and monitors patient progress in clinical and hospital settings.
products: Medical Records, Patient Care Plans, Medication Charts, IV Bags, Monitoring Equipment
tools_and_tech: Stethoscope, Blood Pressure Monitor, EMR Software, Syringes

name: Accountant
description: An accountant manages financial records, prepares tax returns, and ensures compliance with regulations for individuals or organizations.
products: Financial Statements, Tax Returns, Payroll Records, Budgets, Invoices
tools_and_tech: Excel, QuickBooks, SAP, Xero, Tax Software

name: Graphic Designer
description: A graphic designer creates visual concepts for branding, advertising, and digital content using typography, imagery, and layout techniques.
products: Logos, Brochures, Web Banners, Product Packaging, Social Media Graphics
tools_and_tech: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Canva, Figma

name: Teacher
description: A teacher educates students, develops lesson plans, assesses learning progress, and fosters intellectual and social growth.
products: Lesson Plans, Educational Materials, Student Assessments, Report Cards
tools_and_tech: Google Classroom, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Interactive Whiteboards

name: Civil Engineer
description: A civil engineer designs, supervises, and manages construction projects such as roads, bridges, and buildings, ensuring safety and compliance.
products: Roadways, Bridges, Buildings, Water Supply Systems, Urban Infrastructure
tools_and_tech: AutoCAD, Revit, Survey Equipment, GIS Software, Project Management Tools

name: Chef
description: A chef creates recipes, prepares meals, manages kitchen staff, and ensures food quality and safety in restaurants or catering.
products: Menus, Signature Dishes, Meal Plans, Catering Services, Specialty Foods
tools_and_tech: Knives, Ovens, Sous Vide, Food Processors, POS Systems

name: Marketing Manager
description: A marketing manager develops strategies to promote products/services, oversees campaigns, analyzes market trends, and manages budgets.
products: Marketing Campaigns, Brand Guidelines, Market Research Reports, Social Media Content
tools_and_tech: Google Analytics, HubSpot, SEMrush, CRM Software, Canva

name: Lawyer
description: A lawyer advises and represents clients in legal matters, drafts documents, conducts research, and argues cases in court or negotiations.
products: Contracts, Legal Briefs, Case Files, Wills, Court Filings
tools_and_tech: Westlaw, LexisNexis, MS Word, Case Management Software, E-Discovery Tools
